question: Why did Apple's revenue decline in fiscal 2023?
summary: Apple Inc.'s revenue fell in FY2023: $394.33B -> $383.29B (-2.8%). The evidence is consistent with these drivers: (1) inventory piled up as demand fell (demand-led decline); (2) operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue).
supported: Inventory piled up as demand fell (demand-led decline)
Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)

H1: Pricing pressure accompanied lower volumes (gross margin contracted)
H2: Inventory piled up as demand fell (demand-led decline)
H3: Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)

reference: Net sales fell 3% on lower Mac and iPad sales and a stronger US dollar, partly offset by Services (Apple FY2023 10-K, MD&A).
